title: HuJoe's Pills
description: Recreates the popular "Pill Pack" addon-ons from GMod in Minecraft!
body:
## Overview
Pill Packs are a common type of add-on in GMod that let you transform into basically every horror game monster ever.

## Video Showcase
<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/sWd_jNZHFIY" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

## How To Play
Pills can be found in a custom creative menu tab.

_Right-Click_ to use the Pill Item to Transform.

_Left-Click on a Player_ to kill a Player as a Pill.
